response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with a strong record of building products, open-source tooling, and teaching/mentoring, but the resume does not meet the role's core hard requirement of 8 years of C++ programming — only roughly 6 months of C/C++ work at National Instruments and an academic project are documented. Similarly, there is limited evidence of large-scale infrastructure or cloud compute platform ownership at the scale implied (the closest is low-latency D services at Sociomantic and a Kubernetes-deployable GIS platform), and no formal technical-leadership title mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. Strong communication, testing discipline, and breadth are real assets, but the gap against the minimum qualifications is too large for this specific role.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering track record across backend, embedded, and web systems
Demonstrated mentoring: workshops, courses, conference talks, community organizing
Real low-latency/high-throughput experience (millions of HTTP req/s at Sociomantic) and OSS platform ownership
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months documented)
No formal technical leadership or team-lead role; largely IC positions
Limited evidence of production cloud compute platform architecture at scale
